questions.question: What are the bonds that have phosphorus and nitrogen as their atom elements?
questions.evidence: have phosphorus as atom elements refers to element = 'p'; have nitrogen as atom elements refers to element = 'n'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.bond_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id IN ( SELECT T3.bond_id FROM connected AS T3 INNER JOIN atom AS T4 ON T3.atom_id = T4.atom_id WHERE T4.element = 'p' ) AND T1.element = 'n'

questions.question: What type of bond is there between the atoms TR004_8 and TR004_20?
questions.evidence: type of bond refers to bond_type; between the atoms TR004_8 and TR004_20 refers to atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND atom_id2 = 'TR004_20' OR another way around
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.bond_type FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20' OR T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR004_20'

questions.question: Please list top three elements of the toxicology of the molecule TR000 in alphabetical order.
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY T.element LIMIT 3

questions.question: List all the elements of the toxicology of the molecule "TR004".
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR004'

questions.question: What is the percentage of carcinogenic molecules in triple type bonds?
questions.evidence: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(bond_type = '#') * 100, COUNT(bond_id)) as percent where label = '+'
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#'

questions.question: What are the elements of the atoms of TR144_8_19?
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.element FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'
